title: Humpty Dumpty: Why Are Eggshells Curved and Super Strong?

lines.text: Humpty Dumpty sat on a wall, Humpty Dumpty had a great fall!
lines.caps: Humpty Dumpty sat *ON | a *WALL, Humpty | Dumpty had a *GREAT | *FALL!

lines.text: Did you know eggshells are actually built like super strong architecture domes?
lines.caps: Did you know eggshells are *ACTUALLY | built like super *STRONG | architecture *DOMES!

lines.text: All the king's horses and all the king's men couldn't put Humpty together again!
lines.caps: All the king's *HORSES | and all the king's *MEN | couldn't put Humpty *TOGETHER | *AGAIN!

lines.text: An egg's curved dome shape spreads weight evenly around the whole shell!
lines.caps: An egg's curved *DOME | shape spreads weight *EVENLY | around the *WHOLE | *SHELL!

lines.text: That is why mother birds can sit on eggs without breaking them at all!
lines.caps: That is why *MOTHER | birds can sit on *EGGS | without breaking *THEM | at *ALL!

lines.text: But when Humpty hits a hard stone wall on one sharp point, the calcium cracks!
lines.caps: But when Humpty hits a *HARD | stone wall on *ONE | sharp point, the calcium *CRACKS!

lines.text: Nature gave eggs dome engineering millions of years before humans built bridges!
lines.caps: Nature gave eggs dome *ENGINEERING | millions of *YEARS | before humans built *BRIDGES!
